content_html:
1. Train to Aguas Calientes (the most popular option)

Taking the train is the most comfortable way to get there.

But you should know:

  • The most requested schedules fill up first
  • Prices increase as the date gets closer
  • The best views tend to sell out early

Ideal for:

  • Travelers looking for comfort
  • Family trips
  • Experiences without physical effort

2. Inca Trail (the most exclusive route)

The famous Inca Trail has extremely limited availability.

Important:

  • Only 500 people are allowed per day (including guides and porters)
  • You must book 3 to 6 months in advance
  • It’s the first option to sell out

Options:
Classic Inca Trail (4 days)
Short Inca Trail (2 days)

Ideal for:

  • Trekking lovers
  • Travelers seeking a unique experience
  • Adventurers

3. Direct entry to Machu Picchu

Even if you are already in Cusco, you still need an entrance ticket.

Consider:

  • There are different tourist circuits
  • Some (like the classic photo spot) sell out faster
  • You can’t freely buy tickets the same day during high season

When should you book?

General recommendation:

  • High season: 2 to 4 months in advance
  • Inca Trail: 4 to 6 months in advance
  • Low season: at least 3 to 4 weeks in advance

The longer you wait, the fewer options you’ll have.

What happens if you don’t book on time?

  • No tickets available
  • You must change your itinerary
  • You pay higher prices
  • You miss the chance to hike the Inca Trail

In many cases, you simply won’t be able to enter Machu Picchu.

Why plan your trip in advance?

Because it’s not just about getting to Machu Picchu…

It’s about:

  • Choosing the best experience
  • Avoiding last-minute stress
  • Securing availability
  • Enjoying your trip without unexpected issues

Book your experience in advance

At GT Peru Travel we help you secure:

  • Official tickets
  • Available trains
  • Routes tailored to your profile
  • Personalized advice

Don’t leave your trip to chance.

Contact us today and secure your visit to Machu Picchu before availability runs out.
